free.question: Is StartFast really free?
free.answer: We offer both free and pro versions. The free version includes all essential features. The Pro version adds internationalization, role-based access, analytics, and premium UI components.

stack.question: What tech stack does StartFast use?
stack.answer: StartFast is built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Better-Auth for authentication, Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL, Stripe for payments, and Resend for emails.

typescript.question: Do I need to know TypeScript?
typescript.answer: While TypeScript knowledge helps, the code is well-documented and follows common patterns. If you know JavaScript, you can work with the codebase and learn TypeScript along the way.

database.question: Can I use a different database?
database.answer: Yes! While we use PostgreSQL by default with Drizzle ORM, you can easily switch to MySQL, SQLite, or other databases supported by Drizzle. Just update the configuration and schema.

deploy.question: How do I deploy StartFast?
deploy.answer: StartFast works great with Vercel (recommended), but you can deploy to any platform that supports Next.js, including Railway, Render, AWS, or your own server.

pro.question: What's included in the Pro version?
pro.answer: Pro includes internationalization (7+ languages), role-based access control, team invitations, advanced analytics with Posthog, blog system, Playwright tests, CI/CD workflows, and premium UI components.

support.question: How do I get support?
support.answer: For free users, we have a GitHub Discussions community where you can ask questions. Pro users get access to priority email support and a private Discord channel.

customize.question: Can I customize the design?
customize.answer: Absolutely! The UI is built with Tailwind CSS, making it easy to customize colors, spacing, and components. You can modify the tailwind.config.ts to match your brand.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.content:
The data controller for this Service is:
- Name: LoveShow (individual/sole trader)
- Privacy Contact Email: noreply@loveshow.life
- Data Protection Officer: Not applicable

dataCollection.title: 2. Personal Information We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect the following types of personal information:
items: Account Information: name, email address, password (encrypted storage), phone number (optional), WeChat ID (optional), profile image.

Payment Information: transaction amount, payment status, Stripe customer ID, subscription information, points balance and transaction history. We do not store complete card numbers — card data is processed by our payment processor (see Section 5).
AI Generation Data: prompts, uploaded images, AI-generated images and audio, lyrics, couple photo inputs and outputs, emotional analysis data, love memoir content.
Communication Records: emails, tickets, and feedback you send to customer support.
Device and Network: IP address, device model, operating system, browser type, timezone, User-Agent.
Usage Behavior: page visits, feature usage, operation logs, session duration.
Session Data: session tokens, IP addresses, and User-Agent information for active sessions (7-day validity).
Third-Party Login: basic profile information obtained when logging in via WeChat OAuth.

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.intro: We use your personal information for the following purposes:
items: Providing and maintaining the Service (Legal basis: Contract performance)
Billing and payment processing (Legal basis: Contract performance)
Customer support (Legal basis: Contract performance / Legitimate interest)
Service notifications — billing, security, policy updates (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)
Security and fraud prevention (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)
Product optimization and analytics (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)
Legal compliance (Legal basis: Legal obligation)
Content moderation — scanning prompts and generated content for prohibited material (Legal basis: Legitimate interest)

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use the following types of cookies and tracking technologies:
items: Strictly Necessary: maintaining login sessions and core functionality. Cannot be disabled.
Functional: language preferences and personalized settings. Can be disabled via browser settings.
Analytics: anonymous usage statistics and product optimization via PostHog (https://posthog.com/privacy). Can be disabled via browser settings.

sharing.title: 5. Sharing and Disclosure of Information
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal information, including as defined by applicable laws such as the CCPA. We only share your information in the following circumstances:
items: Service Providers: cloud computing, payment, customer support, and analytics vendors, all bound by confidentiality agreements. Payment card data is exclusively processed by our PCI-DSS compliant payment processor, Waffo Pancake, and is not stored on our servers.

AI Model and Safety Providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Suno, and Waffo Pancake process prompts and generation requests to provide AI features and pre-generation content-safety checks. Waffo's prompt scan is stateless and does not retain the original prompt after returning a verdict; each provider's own privacy policy also governs its processing.
Storage Providers: Cloudflare R2 and Volcano Engine TOS store user-uploaded and AI-generated content.
Legal and Regulatory Requirements: as required by law, court order, or lawful request from competent authorities.
Business Transactions: in the event of a merger, acquisition, or similar transaction, with advance notice and continued protection obligations.
With Your Consent: for other purposes with your explicit prior consent.

dataSecurity.title: 6. Data Security Measures
dataSecurity.content: We implement the following security measures to protect your personal information:
items: Transmission Encryption: TLS/HTTPS for all data in transit.
Storage Security: passwords and sensitive data are encrypted or hashed (scrypt).
Access Control: principle of least privilege; employees bound by confidentiality agreements.

Content Moderation: all AI generation prompts and textual generation intents are scanned before processing with the Waffo Pancake Content Safety scan-prompt API. Generation proceeds only after an explicit allow verdict; review, block, or an unavailable moderation service prevents generation.

dataRetention.title: 7. Data Retention Periods
dataRetention.intro: We retain personal information for the following periods:
items: Account Information: during account validity; deleted or anonymized within 90 days after account deletion.
Transaction Records: retained for 5 years as required by tax and accounting regulations, then deleted or archived.
AI Generation Data (images, audio, prompts): retained for the duration of account validity; deleted upon account deletion.
Session Data: active sessions retained for 7 days; expired sessions automatically deleted.
Content Moderation Logs: retained for 12 months for security audit purposes, then securely deleted.
Customer Support Records: retained for 2 years, then securely deleted.

dataRights.title: 8. Your Data Rights
dataRights.intro: To exercise any of the following rights, please contact us. We will respond within 30 calendar days.
items: Right to Know: understand what data we collect and how we use it.
Right of Access: obtain a copy of your personal information.
Right to Correction: correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
Right to Deletion: request deletion of your data under certain conditions.
Right to Restrict Processing: pause data processing in specific circumstances.
Right to Data Portability: obtain your data in a machine-readable format.
Right to Object: object to processing based on legitimate interest or marketing.
Right to Withdraw Consent: withdraw consent for processing based on consent.

marketing.title: 9. Marketing Communications and Opt-Out
marketing.content: With your consent, we may send marketing information related to new features, promotions, and service updates via email or in-app notifications. You may opt out at any time by clicking the "unsubscribe" link in emails, disabling marketing notifications in account settings, or contacting us. Opting out does not affect service-essential notifications such as billing and security alerts.

international.content: Our servers and service providers may be located in China, the United States (Cloudflare), and other jurisdictions. When transferring data across borders, we ensure data security through the following measures: signing data processing agreements incorporating EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs); transferring only to recipients with equivalent levels of protection; and complying with applicable data transfer regulations.

aup.title: Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) — AI-Generated Content
aup.intro: LoveShow is committed to providing safe, lawful, and responsible AI content-generation services. This policy applies to all content generated, edited, submitted, distributed, or stored through LoveShow and explains our content standards, platform moderation process, reporting process, and enforcement measures. Every user must follow this policy, which forms part of our Terms of Service.

sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: This policy applies to every LoveShow AI feature and to the related inputs and outputs.
items: Text: prompts, instructions, copy, analyses, and other AI-generated text.
Images: uploaded reference images and AI-generated or edited photos, portraits, and illustrations.
Audio: user inputs, AI-generated lyrics, music, and other audio content.
Account and usage activity: generation requests, sharing behavior, and attempts to evade safety measures.

sections.title: 2. Content Standards and Six Prohibited Categories
paragraphs: LoveShow expressly prohibits using the Service to generate, edit, upload, distribute, or store any of the following six categories. Each category applies to all AI image, image-editing, text, and music features.
items: Pornography / NSFW content: pornography, explicit sexual activity, nudity, sexually suggestive material, sexual solicitation, or other adult content.
Violence / gore: graphic or extreme violence, abuse, self-harm, promotion of suicide, terrorism, or incitement of mass violence.

Hate speech: hatred, discrimination, degradation, harassment, or incitement to harm based on race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, or another protected characteristic.

Child sexual abuse material and child-unsafe content (CSAM): any sexualization, nudity, grooming, exploitation, or abuse involving a minor, including fictional, synthetic, or edited content. We apply zero tolerance to this content.
Deepfakes / impersonation: using a real person's face, voice, or likeness without consent to create misleading or deceptive content, or impersonating an individual, brand, or organization.

Copyright / trademark infringement: generating, editing, or distributing content that uses a third party's copyrighted work, trademark, brand logo, character, patent, trade secret, or other intellectual property without authorization from the rights holder.

sections.title: 2.1 Zero-Tolerance and Other Prohibited Conduct
paragraphs: Child sexual exploitation, terrorism or extremism, instructions for weapons of mass destruction, incitement of genocide, and non-consensual sexual deepfakes of real people are zero-tolerance content. When identified, we immediately restrict access, preserve necessary evidence, and report to competent authorities where required by law.
items: Generating or distributing fraud, illegal drugs, weapons, explosives, malware, or other unlawful content that endangers public safety.
Uploading or using photos, music, trademarks, works, personal information, or likenesses that you do not own or have permission to use.
Generating or spreading misinformation, or deceptively presenting AI-generated content as human-created.
Bulk-generating spam, harassment, phishing, fraudulent, or manipulative content.
Using jailbreak prompts or other methods to bypass content moderation, safety filters, access controls, or platform restrictions.

sections.title: 3. Platform Content Moderation Process
paragraphs: We use a layered system of automated screening, human review, and periodic sampling. Decisions consider context, potential harm, severity, repeat behavior, and applicable law.

subsections.title: 3.1 Automated Review (Real Time)
items: Input screening: before a generation model is called, the Waffo Pancake Content Safety scan-prompt API scans prompts, instructions, and generation intent for keyword, semantic, and safety risks. Only an explicit allow verdict proceeds; review and block verdicts are stopped.

Output screening: generated outputs are subject to the safety controls of our underlying mainstream model providers, including OpenAI gpt-image, Google Gemini, and Suno, and to LoveShow's content rules. Outputs detected or flagged as non-compliant are blocked, withheld, or access-restricted.
Abuse-pattern analysis: moderation outcomes and associated request identifiers are logged to identify repeat violations, automated abuse, and attempts to evade safety measures.
If the safety service is unavailable, production uses fail-closed protection: the request is blocked instead of bypassing moderation.

subsections.title: 3.2 Human Review and Report Assessment
items: High-risk requests flagged by automated systems, user reports, intellectual-property complaints, and suspicious account activity may enter human review.
Reviewers assess this policy, the report, relevant inputs and outputs, request records, context, and evidence of rights while keeping the reporter's identity confidential.

If evidence is insufficient, we may request a content URL, generation job ID, screenshot, proof of ownership, or contact details. We do not impose an enforcement action solely on an unverified allegation.
At least monthly, we sample moderation records and resolved cases and use the findings to adjust rules, filters, and enforcement procedures.

sections.title: 4. Reporting Mechanism and Reporting Channel
paragraphs: To report content or conduct that violates this policy, email noreply@loveshow.life. This monitored channel accepts content-safety reports, urgent child-safety or terrorism reports, deepfake/impersonation complaints, and copyright or trademark infringement notices during our stated service hours.

Please include, where possible: the content or page URL, generation job ID, a description of the issue, and screenshots. A copyright or trademark notice should also identify the rights holder, provide evidence of ownership, identify the reported material, and include a good-faith statement. We keep reporter identities confidential, review reports independently and objectively, and record or restrict malicious or knowingly false reports.

sections.title: 5. Classification, Response Times, and Review Workflow
paragraphs: Our workflow is: report received → acknowledgement → initial classification → automated records and human review → enforcement decision → action → outcome notice. If a complex case requires more time, we will explain the delay.
items: L1 Critical (child safety, terrorism, and similar risks): priority review with an initial action targeted within 24 hours; access may be blocked and authorities notified immediately where necessary.
L2 High Risk (serious infringement, non-consensual deepfakes, severe violence, or hate): initial response targeted within 1 business day and resolution within 3 business days.
L3 Medium Risk (general violations or repeated abuse): initial response targeted within 3 business days and resolution within 7 business days.
L4 Low Risk (minor issues or complaints with insufficient evidence): initial response targeted within 5 business days and resolution within 15 business days.

sections.title: 6. Enforcement Actions
paragraphs: After confirming a violation, we take one or more actions based on severity, reach, account history, and cooperation. Zero-tolerance content does not require a prior warning.
items: Reject or block a generation request and notify the user that it violates the content policy.
Issue a warning and require deletion, modification, or cessation of distribution.
Remove content, withhold an output, or revoke access to a shared item.
Restrict features, reduce generation limits, or apply enhanced screening to future requests.
Temporarily suspend an account pending further review.
Permanently terminate the account and access to the Service.
Preserve necessary records and report to or cooperate with law enforcement, competent authorities, or relevant rights holders where legally required or an urgent safety risk exists.

sections.title: 7. Appeals, Policy Updates, and Contact
paragraphs: If you believe content or an account was acted on in error, email an appeal to noreply@loveshow.life within 15 days of notice. Include the account email, generation job or case ID, grounds for appeal, and supporting evidence. Where practicable, a person not involved in the original decision will review the appeal, with completion targeted within 10 business days; we will explain delays in complex cases.

We may update this policy to address changes in law, the product, or safety risks. Material changes will be announced on the website or sent to the registered email address. Continued use means acceptance of the updated policy. Content-safety, reporting, and appeals contact: noreply@loveshow.life.

creditExpiry.content:
6.1 Credit Validity
Purchased credits are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase unless otherwise stated at the time of purchase. We will send reminder notifications before credits expire.

6.2 Account Termination
If an account is terminated (by you or by us), unused credits will be retained for 30 days after termination. After that period, unused credits will expire and will not be refunded unless required by applicable law.

refunds.title: 7. Refund Policy
refunds.content: Consumed credits are generally non-refundable. The following exceptions apply:
items: Unused credits within 7 days of purchase: Full refund available if credits have not been used within 7 days of purchase.
Duplicate charges: Full refund for duplicate charges caused by billing errors.
Statutory rights (EU/UK/Australia): The 14-day withdrawal right for first-time purchasers is preserved and no longer applies after first use.

billingDisputes.title: 8. Billing Disputes
billingDisputes.content: If you believe a charge is incorrect, please email noreply@loveshow.life before filing a dispute with your bank. We commit to responding within 2 business days and resolving confirmed billing errors within 5 business days.

aiContent.title: 9. AI Content and Intellectual Property
aiContent.content:
9.1 Output Ownership
Subject to these Terms, AI-generated content created from your inputs ("Output") belongs to you. You may use Output for any lawful purpose within the scope permitted by Section 10.

9.2 Input License
By submitting content to the Service ("Input"), you grant LoveShow a limited, non-exclusive license solely to provide the Service to you. Without your explicit consent, we will not use your Input to train AI models.

9.3 Third-Party AI Model Dependency
The Service uses third-party AI model providers, including OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Suno. Output may be influenced by these providers' models. We do not guarantee specific output quality and are not responsible for content generated by third-party models.

9.4 AI Output Accuracy
items: AI-generated content may contain errors or inaccuracies. You are responsible for reviewing and verifying Output before relying on it.

acceptableUse.title: 10. Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.intro: These rules apply together with the complete Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) published at https://loveshow.life/en/aup. To keep the platform safe for everyone, the following six categories of content are strictly prohibited when using any AI generation feature (including AI image creation and editing, AI music, and AI text generation):
items: Pornography / NSFW Content: NSFW, sexually explicit, pornographic, suggestive, nude, or adult content of any kind.
Violence / Gore: Gore, extreme violence, self-harm, suicide promotion, or terrorism-related content.
Hate Speech: Hate speech, discrimination, harassment, or content targeting protected groups.
Child Safety (CSAM): Any sexualized, exposed, or exploitative content involving minors. Such requests trigger immediate account termination and will be reported to the relevant authorities.
Deepfakes / Impersonation: Deepfakes or misleading impersonation of real people (public figures or private individuals), including non-consensual use of another person's face or likeness.

Copyright / Trademark Infringement: Generating content that infringes any third party's intellectual property rights, including unauthorized use of copyrighted works, trademarks, logos, patents, or trade secrets.

subsections.title: General Prohibited Conduct
subsections.intro: In addition to the six categories above, the following conduct is also prohibited:
items: Illegal activities: fraud, drugs, weapons, explosives, or other content endangering public safety.
Attempts to bypass content moderation, jailbreak our safety systems, or attack our infrastructure.
Uploading photos of people you do not have the legal right to use.
Generating or spreading misinformation, or presenting AI-generated content as human-created in order to deceive.
Bulk generation of spam or fraudulent content.

subsections.title: Platform Content Moderation Process (Summary)
subsections.intro: We enforce this policy through a multi-layered moderation system that combines automated review and human review:
items: Automated review (real time): before generation, the Waffo Pancake Content Safety scan-prompt API scans prompts, instructions, and generation intent; only action=allow proceeds. action=review, action=block, service degradation, or request failure is blocked by fail-closed protection. Outputs are also subject to the safety controls of our underlying model providers and LoveShow's content rules.

Human review: staff assess high-risk requests flagged by automated systems, user reports, intellectual-property complaints, and suspicious account activity, including relevant inputs and outputs, context, request records, and evidence of rights.

Periodic sampling: at least monthly, we sample moderation records and resolved cases to evaluate accuracy and improve rules, filters, and enforcement procedures. See the separate AUP page for the complete workflow, severity levels, response times, and appeals process.

subsections.title: Reporting and Report Handling
subsections.intro: If you encounter abuse or prohibited content, please report it to noreply@loveshow.life. Every report is handled as follows:
items: Acknowledgement: severe violations (e.g., child safety, terrorism) receive an initial response within 24 hours; all other reports receive an initial response within 3 business days, with resolution targeted within 7 business days.
Review: each report is manually reviewed against this policy, and the reporter's identity is kept strictly confidential.

Outcome: confirmed violations result in the enforcement actions described below, and the reporter is notified of the result. Malicious or knowingly false reports are logged and may themselves be treated as violations.

subsections.title: Enforcement Actions
subsections.intro: Depending on the severity and frequency of the violation, we apply the following escalating measures at our sole discretion:
items: Written warning with a request to remove or modify the content (first minor violation).
Removal of the violating content (confirmed violations).
Feature restrictions or reduced generation quota (repeated or moderate violations).
Temporary account suspension pending review (serious or accumulated violations).
Permanent account termination (zero-tolerance content or repeated serious violations).
Reporting to law enforcement and cooperating with investigations where required by law (e.g., child safety or terrorism-related content).

dataPrivacy.title: 11. Data, Privacy and Security
dataPrivacy.content: Your use of the Service is governed by our Privacy Policy, published at https://loveshow.life/privacy. Payment card data is exclusively processed by our PCI-DSS compliant payment processor, Waffo Pancake, and is not stored on our servers. Account data is retained for 90 days after cancellation, after which it is deleted.

disclaimer.title: 12. Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability
disclaimer.content:
12.1 Disclaimer
The Service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis, without any express or implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or AI output accuracy.

12.2 AI-Generated Content Disclaimer
⚠️ AI-generated content may be inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated. Do not use it for legal, medical, financial, or other professional advice. Always verify with qualified professionals before acting on AI-generated content.

12.3 Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, LoveShow shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages. Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months preceding the claim event.

termination.title: 13. Term and Termination
termination.content: These Terms remain in effect while you use the Service. We may suspend or terminate your account if you materially breach these Terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or as required by law. If we terminate the Service for reasons other than your breach, we will refund the unused portion of prepaid fees on a pro-rata basis. You may delete your account at any time by contacting noreply@loveshow.life.

governingLaw.title: 14. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
governingLaw.content: These Terms are governed by the laws of China. Before initiating formal proceedings, please email noreply@loveshow.life to attempt informal resolution.

generalTerms.title: 15. General Provisions
generalTerms.content: We may update these Terms at any time. Material changes will be notified via email at least 14 days before the effective date. Continued use constitutes acceptance. If any provision is found invalid, the remaining provisions remain in full effect. These Terms and the Privacy Policy together constitute the entire agreement between you and LoveShow.

contact.title: 16. Contact Information
contact.intro: If you have any questions about these Terms or billing, please contact us:
